_note: The till's half of the Bazaar (#174), now reckoned in a campaign's own
coin (#195). Implemented twice — backend/internal/http/money.go so the
server can charge, frontend/src/lib/money.ts so the Buy button knows
affordability without a round trip — and this file keeps them honest.
Everything is in BASE units, the ladder's smallest coin, because that is
the only unit every price and every purse can be stated in exactly. A
sub-base remainder rounds UP: the shopkeeper's handling fee, kept from
#174. A null base means the till refuses — prose prices ("a favor owed")
are legal on a shelf and simply not buyable, and so is a coin this table
This replaces price-gold.json, whose answers were in whole gold because
gold was the only unit a purse could hold. The worth is unchanged: a purse
of 120 gp became 12,000 cp in the same migration, so 15 gp still buys what
it always bought. What changed is that a copper now costs a copper rather
than being rounded up to a whole gold piece.
